question: In the central composite design for α-terpineol enrichment, what α-terpineol content was obtained in the run at 150 Pa, 30 °C and 2 mL/min?
rendered:
Document 1 is the most relevant to this question.

The experimental data for the central composite design are listed in Table 1 in Document 1. 

The row corresponding to the run at 150 Pa, 30 °C, and 2 mL/min is:

| Coded variables |  |  |  |  |  |
| Pressure | Evaporator surface | Feed | a-terpineol |  |
| Ex | X1 (Pa) X2 (°C) | X3 (mL min^−1) | X1 | temperature X2 | X3 | content (%) |
| 5 | −1 −1 | 1 | 150 | 30 | 2 | 58.41 |

Therefore, the α-terpineol content obtained in the run at 150 Pa, 30 °C, and 2 mL/min was 58.41%.
